title: Withdrawing an In-Place Home Resale File: Conditions and Fee
content:
**Withdrawal conditions — In-Place Home Resale.** Withdrawing is the seller's own act and is available while the file is opened or listed; a home under contract cannot be withdrawn, being bound to the buyer under the purchase agreement.

A listed home withdrawn before the package's fee-free number of calendar days have passed since the listed date is charged the package's withdrawal fee on the withdrawal date. A withdrawal on or after that day, a withdrawal before the home was ever listed, and any withdrawal on a package whose withdrawal fee is 0.00 carry no withdrawal fee. The days are counted from the day after the listed date. Fees already charged are not refunded on withdrawal.

| Situation at withdrawal | Withdrawal fee |
|---|---|
| file opened, home never listed | none |
| listed, fewer days passed since the listed date than the package's fee-free count | the package's withdrawal fee |
| listed, the fee-free count of days reached or passed | none |
| any withdrawal on a package whose withdrawal fee is 0.00 | none |
| under contract | withdrawal not available |

## Day counting (hypothetical dates)

| Package | Listed on | Withdrawn on | Days passed | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assisted Resale Listing (295.00; fee-free from day 60) | 1 March | 29 April | 59 | 295.00 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 1 March | 30 April | 60 | none |
| Guaranteed Resale Program (995.00; fee-free from day 90) | 1 March | 29 May | 89 | 995.00 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 1 March | 30 May | 90 | none |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package (0.00) | 1 March | 10 March | 9 | none |

In every row, the package service fee and any other fee charged before the withdrawal stay charged.
